name: flightseatmap
description: Seat maps, seat ratings, traveller reviews and seat alerts for 117 airlines.

interface.shortDescription: Seat maps and the best free seats on 117 airlines.
interface.longDescription: See the real cabin layout for a flight, get the free seats ranked against what you care about (window, aisle, legroom, exit row, quiet zone), read what other travellers said about a seat, set alerts for when a seat opens up or your aircraft, schedule or delay changes, and check baggage, carry-on and WiFi facts for each airline. Open it from the ChatGPT sidebar or beside any conversation.
